name: EPIC 212703856
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 5.3 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212703856 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.313774 (16th-84th percentiles 5.18251-5.482119), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,107 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.84 solar masses and 5.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,936 K at its surface.
